articles.excerpt: On this edition of Fire and Ice, we're checking in with a popular Grixis Dragon maker: Goro-Goro and Satoru. Let's see what's heating up.

articles.value: Iroh, Firebending Instructor Commander Deck Tech
articles.excerpt: This week on Plot Twist, Jeff makes multiple token copies of Iroh, Firebending Instructor while trying to dodge the legend rule.
Double-faced Magic cards have been a big hit with players. Even in the command zone! Let's see which DFC legends lead the most decks.

articles.value: Build a Copy-Themed Deck With Saheeli, the Sun's Brilliance

articles.value: Bottom of the Barrel - Duke Ulder Ravengard
articles.excerpt: Can we make Boros Infect happen with this underplayed commander? We think you'll be surprised at how sick Duke Ulder can make your opponents.
